Method of Attack: Delivered as fake Android apps (APKs) to spy on targets
Uploading collected information to APT servers
Exfiltrating data including installed apps, browser history, calendar info, BBM and WhatsApp audio files, documents, images, voice notes, and IMO app content
Downloading attacker specified content from FTP shares
Running arbitrary commands as root if possible
Scraping BBM messages and contacts via accessibility services
Scraping BBM notifications via accessibility services
Recording WhatsApp calls by abusing Android’s accessibility services
Exfiltrating message content and sender information
Data collected locally in SQLite databases compressed into ZIP files and uploaded to C2 infrastructure
Discoverer: Researchers Apurva Kumar and Kristin Del Rosso
Impacted Systems: Potential candidates for Pakistan Atomic Energy Commission
Individuals linked to Pakistan Air Force (PAF)
Electoral officers in Pulwama district of Kashmir
Attack Vector: Fake Android apps (APKs) distributed outside official app stores
Bootleg Android APKs and iOS apps from risky websites
Indicators of Compromise: Fake app names: 'Google Security Framework', 'Kashmir News', 'Falconry Connect', 'Mania Soccer', 'Quran Majeed'
Periodic calls to PHP pages on C2 server
SQLite databases compressed into ZIP files for exfiltration
